name: Змеиное святилище

The central 55 percent of the image is a quiet continuous deep green-black atmospheric stone and mist area with very low detail and no bright objects, intentionally reserved behind readable profile content. Elegant mysterious yuan-ti aesthetic, muted malachite and charcoal, localized soft jade highlights, premium hand-painted fantasy environment art, sophisticated not neon, no characters, no letters, no UI, no border, no logo, no giant snake face in center. Beautiful usable dark background with clear sculptural edges and restrained depth.
scope: Account profile only, private and public views. Existing banner, avatar, showcases and purchases preserved.
